acknowledgement_rules: acknowledgement records delivery only; it does not fabricate external truth
admissibility_requirements: authority, provenance, freshness, integrity, and ownership boundary validation
canonical_schema: constitutional contract only; implementation schema not specified
completeness_requirements: all required identities, timestamps, and source references present
completion_criteria: all required validations have terminal disposition and evidence has been persisted
correction_rules: no correction without correction authority and predecessor preservation
duplicate_rules: duplicate delivery is recorded without duplicate constitutional mutation
failure_rules: fail closed, preserve anomaly evidence, escalate when authority or source truth is unavailable
freshness_requirements: source-specific freshness rule and temporal doctrine must be available
identity_requirements: explicit object, message, producer, consumer, workflow, account, instrument, position, evidence identities
ordering_requirements: event ordering uses source event time plus explicit sequence; equal timestamps require deterministic disposition
reconciliation_rules: Position Registry records reconciliation cases; source owner retains source-truth authority
replay_rules: replay reproduces original constitutional effect and never creates new external action
retry_rules: retry preserves originating identity and cannot create duplicate mutation
timeout_rules: timeout becomes anomaly evidence and unresolved disposition
